calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.brand, cp.category, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gross_margin
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4 AND cs.region = 'South'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT 'sales_id_dups' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n, COALESCE(SUM(c-1),0) AS extra FROM (SELECT sales_line_id, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'receipt_line_dups', COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(c-1),0) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'return_id_dups', COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(c-1),0) FROM (SELECT return_line_id, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'etl_loaded_distinct_in_Q4', COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(etl_loaded_at AS DATE)), COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'cost_mismatch_lines', COUNT(*), 0 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND ABS(f.standard_cost - f.quantity*p.standard_unit_cost) > 0.02
UNION ALL
SELECT 'null_or_zero_cost_lines', COUNT(*), 0 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND (f.standard_cost IS NULL OR f.standard_cost=0)

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS mine
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter=4 GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS ctl FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
    WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT cs.region, COUNT(*) AS stores, ROUND(SUM(m.mine),2) AS mine, ROUND(SUM(c.ctl),2) AS ctl, ROUND(SUM(m.mine)-SUM(c.ctl),2) AS gap,
       MAX(ABS(m.mine-c.ctl)) AS max_store_gap
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c USING (store_id)
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = COALESCE(m.store_id,c.store_id) AND cs.is_current
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'multi_current_sku' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT sku FROM dim_product WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'multi_current_store', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'south_current_stores', COUNT(*) FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND region='South'
UNION ALL SELECT 'top10_skus_delisted_or_name_changed', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT sku FROM dim_product WHERE sku IN (103075,100955,101763,103390,100953,103062,102468,102538,101398,101888) GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT product_name)>1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT category)>1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT brand)>1)
